name: Yesterday's Dream
source:
You play a girl, Coleko, who wakes up in the middle of snow.
Or rather in the middle of nowhere.
She has no idea what just happened or why she was there.
In fact, she has no recollection of anything at all.

After wandering around a bit, she finds a house to take shelter in.
A rather... strange house.

[From [URL=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=18415]Lemma Soft Forums[/URL]]
translation:
你扮演一个女孩科尔科，她在雪地中醒来。
或者更准确地说，在一片荒芜之地。
她不知道刚才发生了什么，也不知道自己为什么在这里。
事实上，她对任何事情都没有记忆。

徘徊了一阵后，她找到了一栋可以躲避的房屋。
一栋相当……奇怪的房屋。

[来自[URL=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=18415]Lemma Soft Forums[/URL]]
